title: LexBridge
tagline: Bridging legal entities and crypto assets!
description: Lexbridge helps to create a legal entity tied to a crypto address which can be useful for new projects or or tax reasons. It addresses the legal challenges and helps with daily DAO operations. It provides a unified legal structure, multi-party agreements, legal document signing and MOU's
